You turn your companion's head and catch the sharp change in their breathing before the poison can settle.

Rules

Action
Reaction

Equipment / acquisition
A free hand.
Type
Skill / Recovery

Reduce one newly applied temporary Asleep or Poisoned contribution by 2.
